product_title: Resin Lavender Floral Decorative Storage Jar Set with Tray (4 inches)
product_description: Add elegance to your home with this beautiful lavender floral jar set, featuring golden lids, pearl embellishments, and delicate floral detailing. Complete with a matching decorative tray, it is perfect for storing small essentials, decorating your space, or gifting on festive occasions.
product_care_suggestion: Clean the jars and tray gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Avoid soaking in water or using harsh chemicals.
Handle the decorative flowers, pearls, and golden accents with care.
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
